# Track 2 — scored candidates (generated by `scripts/t2/candidatos.py`)

Score = 0.30·Evidence + 0.25·Mechanistic fit + 0.20·Paediatric feasibility + 0.25·Patient-specific safety. Only **approved medicines** are ranked (Track 2 scope, organisers' discussion #5). E counts only evidence about whether a line works; evidence that it could harm this child lowers S instead (it used to be subtracted in both places). Robustness: 2,000 draws of the weights (Dirichlet centred on the chosen weights); the last three columns add, in the same draws, a uniform ±0.30 perturbation of each line's mechanistic fit M and ±0.15 of its safety S — the two most curated inputs — with ties broken at random.

## Therapeutic axis, line by line

`correct` fewer missegregation events · `clear` remove the abnormal cells · `tolerate` help abnormal cells cope · `avoid` do not add insult. Summarised per **line** (its best approved drug), because a mean over drugs would depend on how many drugs were seeded per line.

| Line | Axis | Best approved drug | Score | Rank | Blocked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | correct | niacin | 0.637 | 8 | allele class unmeasured (one blot decides it); rhabdomyosarcoma depends on NAMPT/NAD+ |
| H2 | correct | amlexanox | 0.507 | 15 | UGA-A stop context plus NMD; the agents that correct UGA are not approved |
| H3 | tolerate | sirolimus | 0.627 | 10 | aneugenic in vitro; immunosuppressive; extra myelotoxicity in paediatric RMS (ARST1431) |
| H4 | clear | dasatinib | 0.73 | 1 | no senolytic ever tested in a BubR1 model; best human RCT missed its endpoint |
| H5 | clear | hydroxychloroquine | 0.565 | 13 | cell-line evidence only; would also deplete normal mosaic tissue |
| H6 | tolerate | ruxolitinib | 0.72 | 2 | may weaken immune clearance of aneuploid cells; no interferon signature measured in MVA |
| H7 | correct | arimoclomol | 0.66 | 5 | raising HSF1 is aneuploidy-tolerating; antioxidants promote tumours in mice |

## What would change the ranking: two facts the clinical team can establish

Same E and P; only the inputs that encode today's two patient-specific uncertainties about the corrective NAD⁺ line change — the allele class (M of H1 = 0.8 × P(class A), now 0.6) and the active-tumour concern (curated S penalty of H1, now 0.35).

| Scenario | #1 | #2 | #3 | Best corrective drug (rank) | Top 7 by axis (correct / clear / tolerate) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| as scored today | dasatinib | ruxolitinib | tofacitinib | arimoclomol (5) | 3 / 1 / 3 |
| allele class A confirmed (rung 1 blot) | dasatinib | ruxolitinib | niacin | niacin (3) | 3 / 1 / 3 |
| documented remission (NAMPT concern 0.35 → 0.10) | dasatinib | ruxolitinib | niacin | niacin (3) | 3 / 1 / 3 |
| both | niacin | nicotinamide | dasatinib | niacin (1) | 3 / 1 / 3 |
